required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Open/free source snapshot exists locally, is hash-bound, and satisfies source separation policy.

required_source.requirement: Acquire and hash ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 studies and reported outcome modules from https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=completed%20interventional%20phase%203&format=json&pageSize=100.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Target table is locked before scoring and hidden fields do not leak into model selection.

required_target.requirement: Lock completed interventional trials and hide reported primary outcome direction and biomarker shift fields until the OC scoring pack is preregistered.
required_target.unit: directional effect class with reported outcome measure units retained per study

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC prediction/scoring rule is preregistered before target unsealing.

required_model.requirement: OC continuum-state prediction over disease context, intervention boundary, biomarker axis, threshold shift, and outcome-cycle response.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Incumbent comparator is scored on the same held-out targets.

required_comparator.baseline_name: condition-intervention historical majority and phase-stratified outcome baseline
required_comparator.requirement: Predict the held-out outcome direction from condition, intervention class, phase, and historical public outcome frequencies locked before the target slice.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC residual advantage exceeds preregistered materiality threshold under uncertainty.

required_uncertainty.metric: bootstrap confidence interval over held-out outcome-direction residuals
required_uncertainty.requirement: Report 95 percent bootstrap intervals and fail closed when intervals cross the materiality threshold.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Negative controls and falsifiers are declared and replayed without post-hoc adjustment.

required_falsifier.requirement: Trigger if OC does not beat the preregistered comparator, if target fields leak into design, or if the negative control retains advantage.
